# Horse Race project instructions

## Technology

- Use React with TypeScript and Vite.
- Do not install additional dependencies.
- Do not use the `any` type.
- Keep components small and focused.

## Player setup

- Players must be addable using the button or Enter key.
- Reject empty and duplicated player names.
- Require at least two players to start.
- Disable player management during a race.

## Race

- Display every horse on a separate lane.
- Make horse movement clearly visible.
- The race should last between 5 and 7 seconds.
- Horses should progress at different speeds.
- Clearly display the winner.
- Allow another race with the same players.
- Reset positions, timers and winner before another race.

## Verification

- Verify the complete flow manually.
- Run `npm run lint`.
- Run `npm run build`.
- Fix errors instead of disabling validation rules.
